messages:
Jay R: quick handoff — I'm signing out in 10. There's an active page INC-3845 (kv-cache thrash) I'm dropping into the thread so ownership is clear. Current impact: increased p95 tail latency on generation requests, ~2% 500s from seatbelt-service. Mitigations in progress (cache warm, gradual rollback candidate queued).
Maya S: thanks — I'm taking primary as I have the repro on my laptop. Jay, can you confirm you assigned the driving role in PD?
Jay R: assigned driving to Maya in PD (see note). Also set comms_owner as unassigned — want someone to handle customer comms and incident updates. Priya or Leo can you pick that up?
Priya K: I can own comms for the next 30m while Leo spins up the warm cache script. I'll post updates to the incident channel and the status page.
incident-bot: Incident INC-3845 | status: mitigation in progress | severity: S2 | assigned: Maya S (driver) | watchers: Jay R, Priya K, Leo T
Leo T: starting cache-warm job now (`scripts/cache_warm.sh --service=seatbelt-service --concurrency=4`). ETA ~6m. If failures persist I'll scale down the qps to the backend and enable fallback quantized model.
Maya S: repro steps in runbook section 2: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrashing — follow the checklist under "Immediate Mitigations". I'm proceeding to roll back the last deploy to canary-2 to reduce pressure, doing a staged rollback 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
Jay R: note for whoever takes longtail: if rollback doesn't hit tail, enable `kv_cache_disable_prefetch` (temporary) and toggle `seatbelt_service.max_concurrent_requests=60`. Both are in the runtime flags page.
Priya K: posted update to status page: "Degraded performance for generation endpoints; mitigation in progress. Next update in 10m or on significant change." Will ping legal/CS if we hear any escalation.
Maya S: first rollback step (10%) complete. p95 down 8% but still above SLO. Continuing to 50%.
Leo T: cache-warm completed, hit rate improving from 18% -> 46%. Starting to reduce backend qps to 70% as a precaution.
Priya K: quick heads-up — customer A reported an elevated error rate via support ticket #4521. I replied with current mitigation note and ETA.
Jay R: thanks team. Two operational notes before I go: 1) backup coverage gap 03:00-05:00 UTC tomorrow — we don't have an on-site match for Maya in that window. Can we confirm handover before that window or set an override policy? 2) If the rollback finishes and latency returns to baseline, Priya please close the incident and run the postmortem checklist.
Maya S: noted on the window. I'll reach out to on-call rota to confirm a handover at 02:45 UTC. If no taker, we'll set temporary autoscale floor to avoid spike.
Priya K: will run the postmortem checklist and capture timeline once we close. I'll mark comms ownership until I handover to whoever is on duty.
Leo T: monitoring looks healthier. I'll stay available for 20 more mins then handoff to Maya if needed.
Maya S: handing off driving to Leo in 20 if metrics keep trending better, otherwise I'll continue. Priya has comms. Jay — enjoy the off shift! :thumbsup:
Jay R: thanks all — leaving the bridge. Good handoff. :slightly_smiling_face:
